notes.title: Open Beta Test + update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

As May is coming to an end and we're all already thinking about the summer, we want to give you a little bit of sunshine. Today we want to share with you some new information about Natural Instincts' latest update. 

What has been changed, fixed, or added?

Updates are based on your suggestions and bug reports. Therefore, we want to thank you for your support and your commitment to providing us with your feedback. It is of great value to us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/b3d3d274cb3e5dfb40b92daadfb5c2b944a7d58d.jpg

Added: 

 Custom cursors
 Animals local avoidance
 Animals run away to die alone
 Time controlling hotkeys
 Animals run away from cars
 New tooltips
 Subtitles


Fixed:

 Minor bugs
 Quest in wolves campaign where you need to kill deers
 Tutorial camera fade
 Better animals hitboxes
 Animals growth system
 Animals ragdolls


Changed: 

 Boar textures
 Rabbits entering the den
 Garbage truck quest


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101468/14844aa7ebe1307c76bc1b0f9c1de187e7fb1c9d.jpg

Open beta tests

Those of you who already received a game key for closed beta tests or backed the game on Kickstarter may already test the newest build with all updates mentioned above. We would be grateful if you could give us your feedback on it as well! Here's a short survey for you!

And that's not all! More improvements are coming before the Early Access launch on July 1, 2021! Keep an eye on the upcoming announcements to stay on top of the news!

Best regards,
Natural Instincts Team

notes.title: Early Access Release in April!
notes.notes:
📣 We already know the early access release date!  📣 


We can finally announce that Natural Instincts early access will launch at the end of April 2021!

We hope you are just as excited as we are!

Let us know if you have any questions regarding the release.
Don't forget to follow us on Facebook and Twitter ❤️

notes.title: New Natural Instincts update!
notes.notes:
Another Natural Instincts update has been released! What's new? 😮Have a look at the changelog!


Added


 Meadow ambient sounds
 Car sounds
 Controls panel
 Animals can drink from rivers
 Player can now name animals
 Animal action interruption sounds
 End credits
 Graphics settings
 Controls panel in the main menu


Fixed


 Car spawning behavior
 Vegetation texture optimization
 Scripts optimization


Changed


 Animals navigation system
 Main menu design
 Camera movement
 Quests system
 Saving system


What's the surprise?
We are going to add a Story Mode to the game! 🥳❤️
You will be able to play different Natural Instincts campaigns to fully experience the life and behavior of a particular species. Be ready to face new, unique for every species challenges and events! 🐗🐻

notes.title: Natural Instincts Update
notes.notes:
Time for some updates!

The last few months have been intense for us. A lot happened in Natural Instincts, although we mainly focused on fixing bugs reported by our players.


We have some good news, though! Another update is coming to Steam soon, along with many optimization changes and some practical solutions that we will reveal to you with the new version's release!

We know you're looking forward to the game launch. Still, an additional biome and your extensive, though precious, feedback has proven to be so time-consuming that we have to postpone the release date - we want to release the game in a form promised during the Kickstarter campaign. 


Thank you for your patience! 
For the newest updates and latest reports from Natural Instincts, visit and follow us on Twitter and Facebook!
